name: Dish tower
summary: The shared sink drawn as a leaning tower of dishes, each tagged with its owner's face. Tap your own to wash them off; the tower straightens as it shrinks, tapping someone else's nudges them, and an empty sink sparkles.
useWhen: roommates arguing about dirty dishes: 'whose bowl is this', a photo of the sink
sink's full again can everyone wash their stuff
who left the pot soaking for 3 days
dishes pile up every week, need a way to shame people nicely
kitchen cleanup at the house, everyone grab yours
dontUseWhen: food in the fridge going bad (use fridge-cleanout)

sub.description: Line under the title, usually the chat's own complaint, e.g. '“whose bowl is this” ×5 since Sunday'

dishes.description: The pile, bottom first, up to 14 unwashed. kind is one of pot, pan, plate, bowl, mug, glass; owner is a chat member's name or '' for nobody's; label names it ('rice cooker pot'); done true means its owner already washed it

said.description: What people said about the sink, newest last; the last one shows under the picture
